project.static_output_dir_help: If the project only produces static files, Caddy serves them directly from disk — no container runs, and the site costs nothing when nobody visits. Vite and Astro build to dist, Next.js with output: 'export' to out. Leave empty for apps requiring a server (Next.js, Express, APIs).
project.spa_fallback_help: Serves index.html for paths that don't exist as files, allowing deep links to work on direct page load. Enable for React Router or TanStack Router. Leave disabled for Astro, Hugo and Eleventy — they have their own 404 pages.

mcp.title: Connect Claude to Snoat
mcp.intro: Give Claude access to your Snoat account, and it can list your projects, deploy them, read build logs and help you debug — right in the conversation. No key and no install: copy the URL below and paste it into Claude.
mcp.step_open: Open Claude and go to Settings → Connectors.
mcp.step_paste: Paste the URL above and click “Add”.
mcp.step_approve: Sign in to Snoat in the window that opens, then click “Approve”.
mcp.no_key_needed: The connection covers your own account only. Claude never sees your password, and you can disconnect at any time.
mcp.connections_subtitle: Clients that currently have access to your account.
mcp.connections_empty: No clients connected yet. Follow the steps above to connect Claude.
mcp.disconnect_confirm: Disconnect {{client}}? It loses access immediately and has to be approved again to get back in.
mcp.advanced_title: Other clients and the command line
mcp.advanced_subtitle: Claude Code, Cursor, your own scripts — plus API keys for clients without OAuth.
mcp.claude_code_body: Run this in your terminal. Claude Code opens a browser for sign-in the first time, just like the Claude app.
mcp.keys_body: Only for clients that do not support OAuth. The key is sent as “Authorization: Bearer …”, never expires on its own, and grants full access to your account — prefer the connector URL above if your client can use it.
mcp.keys_once_warning: Copy the key now — it is shown this once only.
mcp.keys_revoke_confirm: Delete this key? Clients using it lose access immediately.
mcp.consent_body: An AI client is requesting access to the Snoat account {{account}}. If you approve, it can do the following to your projects:
mcp.consent_permission_read: See your projects, their status and settings
mcp.consent_permission_config: Change build commands, environment variables and custom domains
mcp.consent_permission_logs: Read build logs and traffic analytics
mcp.consent_revoke_hint: Your environment variable values are hidden from the client. You can disconnect at any time under Settings → AI connection.
mcp.consent_login_body: An AI client is requesting access to your Snoat account. Sign in first, and you will see exactly what it is asking for.
mcp.consent_invalid_title: The request is missing or expired
mcp.consent_invalid_body: Start the connection again from your AI client. Requests expire after a while for security reasons.
